company.description: MerXu is an online trading platform for small and medium-sized enterprises. It allows manufacturers, wholesalers, contractors, and retailers to buy and sell industrial products such as office furniture, lighting, machinery, chemicals, and tools. This platform connects verified buyers and sellers, allowing them to conduct direct business and inquire directly. MerXu's mission is to assist all types of businesses in their digital transformation by providing a comprehensive tool for B2B online trading on a national and international scale.
